verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an observability platform like Datadog, but the evidence pack never documents a bulk action across many items. The general REST API, client libraries and MCP server are developer building blocks someone could use to script bulk changes, not a bulk-operations capability. DDSQL querying is read-only querying, an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
